context: A FastAPI orders.py mixes handlers, Pydantic models, SQLAlchemy queries, and discount logic. The criteria check whether the reasoning generalises beyond React, prefers a real abstraction over reflexive splitting, co-locates coupled handler+logic, and applies the isolation/line guidance — without giving React-specific advice.

checklist.name: Applies to Python, not React-specific
checklist.description: Applies the reasoning to Python/backend and does NOT give React- or hook-specific advice

checklist.name: Real abstraction over file split
checklist.description: Recommends a real abstraction (pure function / service / repository) over reflexive file-splitting

checklist.name: Co-locate coupled, separate standalone
checklist.description: Co-locates the tightly coupled handler+logic; separates only cleanly-standalone layers (e.g. discount calc or DB access)

checklist.name: Isolation test / ~300-line guidance
checklist.description: Applies the understood-in-isolation test and/or the ~300-line guidance to the module
